headings.usage: H1-H4, Ecosystem logos, big cinematic numbers, section headers.

body.usage: General UI text, posts, comments, community descriptions.

monospace.usage: Data points, UI labels, time stamps, map coordinates, AI outputs, stats.

visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use subtle drop-shadows with accent colors for key interactive elements, especially AI indicators and Map pins.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle noise/grain over dark backgrounds to avoid pure flat blacks and give it a premium editorial feel.

component_rules.buttons: Sharp rectangular or pill-shaped, rich hover states (e.g. changing border opacity, subtle inner glow), no generic SaaS blue.
component_rules.cards: Cardless or completely flat with 1px border. Never use soft gray shadows. Use intense dark contrast.
component_rules.navigation: Ecosystem sidebar with vertical text or icon-heavy list. Sticky top glass header.
component_rules.map: Leaflet map MUST use a custom dark tile layer (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter or Stadia Alidade Smooth Dark). Map pins should be custom HTML markers with pulsing glass rings.
component_rules.toasts: Use sonner, customized to match the dark glassmorphic theme with JetBrains Mono.

grids.feed: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12. Main feed spans 7 or 8, sidebars/AI span 4.
grids.profile: Bento box style: Large hero banner (col-span-full), dense grid below for skills, stats, and portfolio items.
grids.marketplace: Asymmetrical masonry or tetris grid for creative services to look more like a gallery than a spreadsheet.

layouts.general: Cinematic and dense. Use generous padding (p-8, p-12) for isolated sections, but strict alignment (gap-4) for data-heavy dashboard panels.
layouts.sidebar: Left fixed sidebar for ecosystem, right fixed sidebar for AI/Notifications, center fluid scrollable area.

motion.transitions: Targeted transitions (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). NO transition-all.
motion.interactions: Hover states must increase brightness or add a subtle glow. Click states slightly scale down.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for feed items and grid elements.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA for text. Text over images must have dark gradient overlays or glass scrims.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus ring using accent color or high-contrast white.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden for purely decorative cinematic elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

media.images: High-contrast editorial photography, lightly desaturated to fit the dark theme, or with dramatic cinematic lighting.
media.video: Embeds should have custom glass controls or hover states.

3d_libraries.map: Leaflet with React-Leaflet, utilizing custom dark tiles and D3/SVG layers for animated data lines.
3d_libraries.background: Framer Motion for parallax effects and fluid layout transitions.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as generic gradients. Use deep solid colors with glassmorphic overlays.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) and 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use standard icon libraries (Lucide) exclusively.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Use the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text or placeholder image services.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
DO NOT use raw HTML date inputs or select dropdowns for complex interactions. Use Shadcn components instead.
For the AIAH assistant panel, avoid generic tech blue. Use Cinematic Cyan (#00E5FF) sparingly against deep space black.
You have .js files not .tsx file, so share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the ecosystem sidebar and global discovery map feel like the crown jewels of the app. The map MUST use Leaflet, customized heavily to look cinematic, not like a standard Google Map. The entire app should feel like a hybrid between an art gallery, an exclusive club, and a high-end command center. Stick strictly to the specified font families.
